_meta.status: PRIOR — NOT VERIFIED AGAINST THE FILE
what_this_is: This is a *candidate* mapping written from the published data description
(Vehkaoja et al., Data in Brief 2022) before the CSV was in hand. It exists so
the DDL has a shape to compile against, NOT so anyone can skip profiling.
scripts/profile_dataset.py reads the real CSV header and the real distinct
label values and writes ref/column_map.json, which is what every other script
actually loads. If ref/column_map.json is absent, load_raw.py refuses to run.
Guessing column names here costs an hour of silent nulls. Do not skip Gate A.

_comment: Raw label value -> TELLTAIL ethogram state. Rebuilt at Gate A from the real
distinct values with counts. Anything in the file and not in this map lands
as state_source='UNMAPPED' and is counted loudly, never silently dropped.

expected._comment: Assertions load_raw.py checks after COPY INTO. A mismatch aborts.
